text: Vanakkam, is the Ghee traditional bilona churned here in Sivakasi?

Vanakkam Karthik sir! Yes, this is Kogila Selvaganesh from Rahu Milk Products, Bharathi Nagar, Sivakasi. Our ghee is 100% pure traditional bilona hand-churned from fresh cultured butter. It has that rich golden granular (danedar) texture and heavenly aroma!
Hello madam, can you deliver 2kg Milk Gova to Kamaraj Nagar before 1 PM?
Yes Meenakshi ma'am! We have packed the fresh morning batch slow-cooked in our Bharathi Nagar dairy unit. Our rider is dispatched and will reach you within 45 minutes!
